gitignore:
# ============================================================
# .gitignore - Pakistan MCQs Hub (Phase 34 final release)
# ============================================================

# --- Dependencies (never committed; zero-dependency project) ---
node_modules/
desktop/node_modules/

# --- Environment files (secrets stay local; example is committed) ---
.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# --- Production database (2.2 GiB - exceeds GitHub 100 MiB hard limit) ---
db/*.sqlite
db/*.sqlite-shm
db/*.sqlite-wal

# --- Database files anywhere (never commit live data) ---
*.sqlite
*.sqlite3
*.sqlite-wal
*.sqlite-shm
*.db

# --- Historical DB backups (kept locally for the restore feature) ---
backup/*/

# --- Phase 23 database source payload (large binary; LFS attributes ready) ---
database/data/
database/releases/
database/snapshots/
database/manifests/.export-checkpoint.json
database/manifests/.export-checkpoint.json.bak-*
database/manifests/.build-state.json
*.part.tmp

# --- Phase 34 cleanup snapshot (outside the repository) ---
phase34-backup-*/

# --- Test fixtures / caches ---
.phase26-db-test/
coverage/
.cache/

# --- Phase 40 sqlite rollback copy (outside the repository, never pushed) ---
migration-backups/
.tmp/
temp/

# --- Audit scratch ---
.audit-tmp/
.claude/

# --- Logs / temp / backups / editor swaps ---
*.log
*.tmp
*.temp
*.bak
*.old
*.swp
*.orig
*.part
*.har
*.zip
*.7z

# --- Generic local dirs (keep the candidate tree clean) ---
logs/
cache/
snapshots/

# --- OS junk ---
Thumbs.db
Desktop.ini
.DS_Store

# --- IDE local state ---
.vscode/
.idea/
*.code-workspace

# --- Browser test artifacts ---
playwright-report/
test-results/
gitattributes:
# ============================================================
# .gitattributes - Pakistan MCQs Hub (Phase 34 final release)
# ============================================================

# Normalize line endings for text files (LF in the repository)
* text=auto

# --- Specific text types ---
*.html  text
*.css   text
*.js    text
*.cjs   text
*.mjs   text
*.json  text
*.md    text
*.yml   text
*.yaml  text
*.xml   text
*.txt   text
*.sql   text
*.sh    text eol=lf
*.cjs   text
*.webmanifest text
*.svg   text
*.conf  text
*.nojekyll text

# --- Binary files: never diff ---
*.png   binary
*.jpg   binary
*.jpeg  binary
*.gif   binary
*.webp  binary
*.ico   binary
*.avif  binary
*.woff  binary
*.woff2 binary
*.ttf   binary
*.eot   binary
*.sqlite binary
*.gz    binary
*.zst   binary
*.zip   binary

# --- Phase 23 NDJSON source payload (if ever tracked: use Git LFS) ---
# *.ndjson      -text
# *.ndjson.gz   filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
# *.ndjson.zst  filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
